description: FOVEATION IS A HINT, NEVER FIXED (2026-07-11). The reading aperture (seeds/register_source.json's `stages`/`max_sentences`/`window` on a winning ShapeSignatureRegister) sets the INITIAL plan only. This seed is the RESIDUAL-DRIVEN ESCALATION layer over it: three rules read signals the read's OWN output already produced -- a truncation datum (sentences_read < sentences_total, stamped mechanically by reading_drive._shim_spine on the flow's Source), a heavy fallback-parse ratio among the flow's own SentenceParse nodes, or a narrative-shaped spine under a light hint -- and, within a held, per-register ApertureBudget belief (never a Python literal), mint ADDITIONAL AnalysisStage nodes for the SAME flow. Minting a new pending AnalysisStage for a flow IS the escalation: the existing la_dispatch_* rules (seeds/literary_analysis_driving.json, unchanged) dispatch it and the SAME run_rules/cognitive_tick fixpoint (reading_drive._tick_reading) carries it to completion -- no new dispatch machinery, no Python decision. A clean, short read (sentences_read == sentences_total, no fallback parses, no narrative shape) escalates ZERO times: every guard above is false, so no rule ever fires and a normal chat turn pays only its spine cost. || DYNAMIC-THRESHOLDS + REOPEN + REFORM (v1.1.0, 2026-07-11): every ApertureBudget row now ALSO holds the reading-layer thresholds (trace_capacity_base/min/max, max_revisits, max_order_base/max, widen_step, widen_salience_threshold, reform_eviction/residual/swallowed_threshold, reform_pressure_factor) -- the ring buffer capacity, backtrack bound, and order-N descent depth are held per-register beliefs, never Python literals. Two held Program (Term-tree) derivations make the EFFECTIVE values DYNAMIC over the flow's own complexity/overflow signals: reading_derive_trace_capacity = Min(Max(base + (widened ? widen_step : 0), min_cap), max_cap) and reading_derive_max_order = Min(base + (reform_count>=1 ? 1 : 0), max_cap) -- domains/reading_norms.py evaluates them via native.evaluate (the review_license/global_contradiction idiom); EDITING EITHER THE BUDGET ROW OR THE PROGRAM NODE CHANGES BEHAVIOUR WITH ZERO CODE (gated in tests/test_dynamic_thresholds_migrated.py). Two new rules complete the overflow-response LADDER: reading_widen_capacity_once (rung 1 -- a flow whose live ring evicted a trace at/above widen_salience_threshold sets capacity_widened=1 on its own Source, once) and reform_overcomplex_clause (rung 2 -- a SentenceParse whose own measurements, residual_marker_count / swallowed_ratio, cross the held reform thresholds -- TIGHTENED by reform_pressure_factor once the widen is already spent -- is marked reform_pending; the mechanical executor reading_drive._execute_pending_reforms, invoked by the always-on reform_reflex in seeds/reading_reform_reflex.json, runs read_clause_order_n and records the part_of/marker component predications: 'if a concept is too complex, take it and reform your own understanding into component shapes'). A simple clause (0 residual markers, 0.0 swallowed) never crosses either threshold.

microtheory.name: reading_aperture
microtheory.description: The aperture is a hint the read may widen from its OWN output: truncation, a heavy parse-fallback ratio, or an unexpected narrative shape each mint additional AnalysisStage nodes for the same flow, bounded by a held per-register ApertureBudget.

attrs.note: chat-turn aperture: at most ONE escalation event per turn (any of the three rules), but the STAGE ceiling stays generous (15, headroom above the 1 initial spine stage + up to 9 more for a full narrative-shape escalation) so a genuine narrative pasted into chat can still escalate to full depth in that one event -- the shadow-read latency battery only ever pays for a clean turn's SPINE cost plus, rarely, one escalation.

document register: `stages=None` already mints all 10 stages up front (byte-identical pre-wave), so the ceiling must clear 10 PLUS escalation overhead (e.g. a re-minted 'spine' on truncation) -- generous headroom, non-binding this wave; max_escalations is the operative lever.
a pasted casual text: more than a live chat turn, less than a full document.
code has no narrative subject; escalation is rarely useful but not forbidden.
every pre-wave caller that never threaded a register (run_reading_flow's own default) -- byte-identical generous document-style headroom; see wikipedia's note on why the ceiling clears 10.

rules.name: escalate_truncated_read
rules.comment: FOVEATION-AS-HINT (task 2a): the flow's own Source shows sentences_read < sentences_total (task 1's truncation datum) -- the aperture hint cut the text short. Widen: set max_sentences_override to the FULL sentence count and re-mint a 'spine' AnalysisStage (escalated=1, escalation_reason='truncated_read') for the SAME flow -- the existing la_dispatch_spine rule (unchanged) dispatches it, and _shim_spine (domains/reading_drive.py) detects the override + prior sentences_read, supersedes this flow's own spine output, and re-collapses over the wider text. Mint-once per flow (the escalated-spine existence guard) + budget-gated (ApertureBudget, held per register, revisable).

rules.name: escalate_unparsed_clauses
rules.comment: FOVEATION-AS-HINT (task 2b): a HEAVY fallback-parse ratio (>= this flow's own ApertureBudget.fallback_ratio_threshold -- held, revisable, never a Python literal) among THIS flow's own SentenceParse nodes -- read_scope/argstruct both abstained and the weakest read_clause fallback ran, or the sentence yielded NO resolved predications at all -- means the light aperture's parse is unreliable. Widen the SITUATION-MODEL depth: mint 'discourse' (re-derives coherence relations across a WINDOW, which can recover a mis-segmented clause's relation to its neighbours) + 'monitoring' (the EXECUTIVE stage that can flag a GlobalIncoherence outright) -- both already dispatch off `la_dispatch_discourse`/`la_dispatch_monitoring` (unchanged; both need only Count(SmEntity)>0, already true once spine is done). Mint-once per flow (the name-existence guards) + budget-gated.

rules.name: escalate_narrative_shape
rules.comment: FOVEATION-AS-HINT (task 2c): the flow was hinted LIGHT (spine-only, e.g. the conversational aperture) but its OWN spine output already shows narrative shape -- >=3 sentences actually read, >=2 animate SmEntities (coref_category person/animal), and an explicit want/goal SmEvent (verb='want') -- using ONLY signals the spine already minted (no infer_goal/discourse run yet under a light hint). The casual-looking text is actually a story: mint the FULL remaining comprehension depth (every _COMPREHENSION_STAGES name besides 'spine') for this SAME flow. Narrative structurally depends on the whole situation-model chain (infer_goal -> discourse -> infer_causal -> enabling before EnablingChain>0, which la_dispatch_narrative requires) so cherry-picking just 'narrative'+'tom' would deadlock; minting the whole depth lets the EXISTING la_dispatch_* chain (unchanged) cascade it for free over subsequent ticks. Guarded to fire only when NONE of the 9 stages exist yet for this flow (so it never duplicates a partial escalate_unparsed_clauses mint) + budget-gated.

rules.name: reading_widen_capacity_once
rules.comment: DYNAMIC-THRESHOLDS ladder rung 1 (2026-07-11): a flow whose ring buffer (reading_scope.enforce_trace_buffer, called per-commit from coref_entities.read_into_situation_model) just evicted a trace whose salience reached this flow's own ApertureBudget.widen_salience_threshold (held, per-register, revisable) widens its effective trace capacity ONCE (capacity_widened=1 on the flow's Source — read by domains/reading_norms.effective_trace_capacity's held Program). Mint-once (the capacity_widened existence guard) — this is the WHOLE ladder's rung 1; rung 2 (reform_overcomplex_clause below) TIGHTENS instead of widening again once this has fired, per the directive's 'widen once -> reform' ladder.

rules.name: reform_overcomplex_clause
rules.comment: DYNAMIC-THRESHOLDS ladder rung 2 / REFORM (2026-07-11): 'if a concept is too complex, the human approach is to take it and reform your own understanding into component shapes' — a SentenceParse whose own MEASUREMENTS (residual_marker_count — unconsumed order-1 structural markers; swallowed_ratio — reading_scope.swallowed_ratio, the fraction of argument roles that swallow a predication; both stamped mechanically at spine-mint time, domains/reading_drive._mint_sentence_parses) cross this flow's own ApertureBudget.reform_*_threshold (held, per-register) is marked reform_pending — the mechanical shim (reading_drive._shim_monitoring) then executes reading_collapse.read_clause_order_n and records the decomposed part_of/marker component predications back onto this SentenceParse, marking reform_done. A SIMPLE clause (both measurements 0, the common case) never crosses either threshold and never fires. Once the flow has ALREADY spent its rung-1 widen (src.capacity_widened=1), the effective threshold is TIGHTENED by the held reform_pressure_factor (e.g. 0.5 — half the bar) rather than widening the ring further: 'widen once -> reform' — sustained overflow pressure makes the SAME flow more willing to decompose, it never forces a genuinely simple (0/0) clause into reform.
